name: Sera Sumire
source:
She is a student in the class that the protagonist is in charge of. She is tries to appeal to him by shortening her skirt, but he doesn't notice. She has feelings for him.

In reality, she is a family-oriented, caring, and caring person. Because of her slightly childish face, she often wants to be taller than necessary and hates being treated like a child. 

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=213461&gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
